sources.snippet: Whisper Model Sizes Explained: Tiny vs Base vs Small vs Medium vs Large Every Whisper model, compared. Parameters, speed, accuracy, and which one you should actually use. OpenAI's Whisper comes in 9 model variants across 5 size categories: tiny (39M parameters), base (74M), small (244M), medium (769M), and large (1.55B).
